On page 7, Figure 2 (left) shows RACE dev accuracy going from about **40% with 0 layers transferred** to about **59% with 12 layers**.

The text doesn't give these numbers, so I read them off the plotted line in the PDF (page 7). They are estimates to within about ±1 point:

| Layers transferred | RACE dev accuracy (read off the plot) |
|---|---|
| 0 | ≈ 39–40% |
| 12 | ≈ 59% |

The x-axis actually runs to 13, and the line ends there at about 60%. The paper doesn't say why there's a point past 12. So if "all 12" means full transfer, it is probably that last point, at about 60%.

The paper's own comment on this plot (page 7) is that "transferring embeddings improves performance and that each transformer layer provides further benefits up to 9% for full transfer on MultiNLI." It gives no RACE numbers for this experiment in the text.
